correctness.rationale: An element of the deleted-diagonal r-fold product is an r×n array x of probability rows, all entries nonnegative, and for every column i at least one zero. Subtract column averages to obtain z with every row and column sum zero, an element of W=U_r⊗U_n. Its positive invariant homogeneous gauge F(z)=−Σ_i min_j z_ji satisfies F(T(x))=1. For any z∈W with F=1, x_ji=z_ji−min_k z_ki has nonnegative entries, column minima 0 and each row sum one; double-centering inverts it. F is positive on W\{0}, convex as a sum of maxima of linear functionals, and its unit sphere boundary is equivariantly radially homeomorphic to the Euclidean S(W). Thus this is an actual S_n×S_r-equivariant HOMEOMORPHISM for all n≥2,r≥3, dimension (n−1)(r−1)−1. The orientation character is det(U_n)^(r−1)det(U_r)^(n−1), and for each subgroup H, W^H has dimension o_{nr}−o_n−o_r+1 from real permutation-module decompositions; its fixed sphere is empty iff dimension zero. Exact rational examples independently verify inverse identities but the all-parameter result is the direct formula.
